text:
emma-partnerships: Quick sync — proposing a new private-offer construct for appliance + SI bundles: 12m committed spend + 3mo onboarding credit (appliance installer discount) that tails into renewal incentives. Main goals: simplify quoting for SIs, accelerate first 90d consumption, keep renewal economics predictable. thoughts?

josh-sales: Sounds promising. Can we sketch tier bands? I'm thinking: Tier A = 50k commit (4% discount), Tier B = 150k (10%), Tier C = 500k (18%). Onramp credit = 25% of first 3 months usage up to 30k. Also want a 9mo renewal nudge credit.

maria-legal: @emma-partnerships @josh-sales quick legal flags: any credit that looks like "rebate" needs a clear clawback if they downgrade or terminate. Also need to avoid language that implies guaranteed price parity with marketplace. I'll draft standard clauses if you confirm numbers.

emma-partnerships: Good call, @maria-legal. We want conversion path: onramp credit can convert into committed spend credit at renewal if customer hits a usage threshold (>=80% of projected). That avoids refunds.

rahul-ops: Operational note — redemption window needs to map to meter events; recommend tying credits to metered consumption metrics, not to invoice line items. Also ensure SKU mapping for appliance + SI services so we can attribute consumption.

kevin-sis: From SI perspective, important that SIs can co-sell the private offer and invoice professional services separately. We need a small partner margin kick (5% of committed) to be paid out after 90d if baseline adoption met. Otherwise SIs won't push it.

josh-sales: Can we add a simplest SKU map for quoting? e.g.:
```
SKU_MAP = {
  "APPL-BASE-1Y": "committed: 12m apx usage",
  "APPL-ONRAMP-3M": "one-time credit token tied to first 90d usage",
  "SI-ENG-RET": "partner margin token, paid after 90d if adoption > 50%"
}
```

emma-partnerships: Nice. Also plan to offer a "renewal bridge" — if a customer doesn't hit commit by month 11, we offer a 6mo grace extension at 60% of previous commit rate to help conversion. That should reduce churn at renewal.

maria-legal: Bridge is ok but keep max 1 extension. Also we need clear reporting cadence for the partner margin payout (monthly proof of usage + invoice).

rahul-ops: Implementation checklist from infra side: 1) add credit token type in billing system, 2) new metric tag for appliance-hosted requests, 3) partner payout engine flag. I estimate 4 sprints to instrument if prioritized.

kevin-sis: Timing question — when can we pilot with a single hyperscaler SI? We prefer a one-market pilot to validate conversion math before broad launch.

emma-partnerships: Proposal: pilot with APAC SI in May (small cohort), learn for 6 weeks, then scale. @partner-bot can you set a reminder and create a pilot task? :calendar:

partner-bot: Reminder created: pilot-private-offer-apac-split — first checkpoint 2024-05-14.

josh-sales: Next steps I suggest: 1) finalize tier numbers (this week), 2) legal to prepare templated clause, 3) ops to produce ETA for instrumentation, 4) SI to commit to pilot list. I'll own item 1.

emma-partnerships: thanks — I'll collate notes and follow up with a short deck for GTM and a single-slide legal redlines pack. :thumbsup:

kevin-sis: :ok_hand: I'm onboard for pilot.

maria-legal: I'll drop a draft CLA + credit clause by EOD Friday.

emma-partnerships: Great — if anyone has edge cases (gov/reg accounts, appliance air-gapped installs) call them out now so we can exclude or special-case them in the pilot.

josh-sales: Noted — exclude govcloud for pilot.

emma-partnerships: cool. tagging this thread as the single source for pilot decisions. I'll post the deck here once ready.

partner-bot: Thread pinned to #partnerships channel by emma-partnerships.
